replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
While I cannot wait to see your map :)

It is best if you post your map when it is 100% finished. So that when its finished, you can get immediate feedback on your map and ways to improve.

Also, for map submissions it is best to post your topic in the "map releases" section. The "map making" section is primarily used to ask map related questions, announce large community projects, announce a new mapdev, etc.
